title: Forgiveness can change the whole room you live inside.
summary: The shabad does not treat forgiveness as a small emotional adjustment. It opens directly into peace and inhabitable space.
takeaway: Forgiveness is one way grace rearranges the atmosphere.
lifeApplication: Notice what bitterness is making unlivable, then bring that exact knot into Bani.

source.shortMeaning: Forgiveness moves swiftly into peace that fills the room.
source.lifeApplication: Release does not only change mood; it changes the space you move through.

evidence.coreClaim: Forgiveness moves swiftly into peace that fills the room.
evidence.turn: Forgiveness is not the end of the path; it is what makes peace inhabitable.
evidence.practicalImplication: Notice what bitterness is making unlivable, then bring that exact knot into Bani.
